stage_a_definition: Human review history is classified before AOS execution. Bot-only output, merge alone, approval without rationale, and silence do not establish an actionable outcome.

protocol_deviation.reason: AOS execution preceded Stage A review extraction.
protocol_deviation.effect: These cases are excluded from blinded historical-action alignment. They remain eligible for mechanism, timing, exact-SHA, contrast, and message-structure metrics.

cases.outcome: Reviewer requested that validation errors identify the failing file; the author changed error handling, added regression tests, and documented the validation parameter.

stage_b.rationale: AOS warned that no status check was required; the human outcome concerned file-specific validation errors, regression tests, and documentation.

cases.outcome: Human approval is visible, but it contains no rationale from which a problem or action can be extracted.

stage_b.rationale: The approval contains no extractable human problem or action.

cases.outcome: A maintainer requested splitting a broad change because the update task has many downstream users; the author split the work into four pull requests.

stage_b.rationale: AOS warned that no status check was required; the maintainer requested splitting a broad change because of downstream blast radius.

cases.outcome: No public human review outcome was available at the data cutoff.

stage_b.rationale: No public human outcome was available.

cases.outcome: Only an automated deployment-preview comment was available at the data cutoff.

post_aos_exploratory_cases.outcome: Only an automated benchmark comparison was available.
A maintainer requested broader command coverage because Gradle upgrades had caused prior problems; additional commands were executed and reported.

stage_b.rationale: Both concern incomplete verification, but the human request names additional Gradle commands while AOS names a missing required CI aggregator that GitHub already awaited.

post_aos_exploratory_cases.outcome: No public human review outcome was available.

stage_b.rationale: The required-check gate did not model the semantic and scope concerns raised by reviewers.
